name: Todoist
author: mdetweil
description: Todoist tasks in your bar — add, edit and complete without leaving the desktop

barWidget.description: Tasks due today, quick-add, and inline editing

schema.label: Background sync
schema.description: How often the bar count refreshes on its own. Opening the panel always syncs.

schema.label: Task horizon
schema.description: Which due dates count as "up next" in the panel and the bar count.

schema.label: Include overdue
schema.description: Count and list tasks whose due date has already passed.

schema.label: Max tasks listed
schema.description: The panel scrolls past this; the cap keeps a 200-task day from becoming a 200-row popup.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Count shows the number due, Next shows the next task's title, Icon shows nothing but the glyph.

schema.label: Undo window (seconds)
schema.description: How long a completion is held before it is sent. 0 sends immediately with no undo.
